components.css: .ds-card{position:relative;max-width:280px;padding:2.2rem 1.7rem 2rem;background:#fffdf8;border:1px solid rgba(29,25,18,.14);border-radius:4px;color:#1d1912;font-family:Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .35s,border-color .35s}.ds-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:2px;background:#c9a55c;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(122,93,34,.45);box-shadow:0 24px 48px -28px rgba(29,25,18,.45)}.ds-card:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-medal{display:grid;place-items:center;width:3.4rem;height:3.4rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem;background:#0e0c08;color:#c9a55c;border-radius:50%}.ds-card h3{margin:0;font:600 1.5rem/1.2 'Cormorant Garamond',serif}.ds-card p{margin:.7rem 0 0;font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.7;color:#5d5545}.ds-card ul{list-style:none;margin:1.3rem 0 0;padding:1.3rem 0 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(29,25,18,.14);display:grid;gap:.55rem}.ds-card li{position:relative;padding-left:1.1rem;font-size:.9rem}.ds-card li::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.6em;width:.4rem;height:1px;background:#7a5d22}

components.description: The single green element: floating WhatsApp button with a pulsing ring.

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a well-kept notary office: cream paper, black ink and thin gold rules, the visual language of a deed rather than of a startup. Everything is sober and documentary. Authority comes from order, generous margins and a high-contrast serif, never from effects, badges or numbers. The identity is taken from the office's own Instagram (@adv.carrielvieira) and logo: warm black and logo brown, matte gold, a serif with a gold italic flourish, and a widely spaced "ADVOGADOS" signature.

The page alternates warm-black and deed-cream bands. Dark bands carry the person and the promise (hero, about, differentials, contact); cream bands carry the reading (practice areas, process, FAQ). Gold is ink, not paint: it draws lines, frames photographs, marks icons and colors a few words, and it fills a surface only on the primary button.

Motion is quiet. Blocks rise 22px and fade in once as they enter the viewport, cards lift 6px on hover, and the WhatsApp button breathes with a soft ring. Everything stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating warm-black and cream bands; no gradients beyond a faint gold glow in the hero.
Gold as line and accent: 1px rules, offset photo frames, icon strokes, italic emphasis.
Serif display, sans body; italic only on the emphasized tail of a headline.
Square-ish 4px corners; circles only for icon medallions and the WhatsApp button.
Flat surfaces; one soft shadow, on card hover only.

rules.name: The Ink, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Gold draws lines, frames, icons and a few words. The only gold-filled surface is the primary button.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green appears once, on the floating button. Every other WhatsApp CTA is gold.

rules.name: The Gold Tail Rule
rules.body: A headline may end with one italic gold phrase that completes the thought ("…*no campo, nos imóveis e nos negócios.*"). One per headline, always at the end, never a single word. This is an approved exception to the italic-serif detector (user confirmed).

rules.name: The Few Eyebrows Rule
rules.body: Uppercase gold eyebrows appear only where the headline alone would not say what the section is: the hero, "Sobre o advogado" and "Localização e contato". Every other section opens with the headline. Never add more than three besides the hero.

rules.name: The Mat Frame Rule
rules.body: Portrait photographs sit on a 1px gold frame offset about 1rem from the image, never inside a rounded card or a shadow.

dos: Do alternate dark and cream bands, with the person and the promise on dark and the reading on cream.
Do frame portraits with the offset gold mat frame and keep the photos' own black-and-white or desaturated grading.
Do keep every CTA pointing to the same WhatsApp link, in gold, with the one green floating button.
Do use Lucide line icons at 1.5 stroke, inlined as SVG (no icon CDN), in gold or ink gold, inside a medallion or outlined circle.
Do use ink gold, never matte gold, for any gold text on cream; matte gold on cream fails contrast.
donts: Don't add testimonials, counters, result badges or "case won" figures. The OAB rules out the content, and the system has no component for it.
Don't use gold as a background fill beyond the primary button, or add gradients other than the faint hero glow.
Don't round corners beyond 4px or put photographs inside rounded or shadowed cards.
Don't set whole headlines in italic or emphasize single words; the italic gold tail ends the line.
Don't introduce a second accent color. The palette is warm black, cream and gold, plus WhatsApp green on one button.
